resources.string:
To unlock the full game, tap Import Game Files and pick DIABDAT.MPQ from your copy of Diablo (Hellfire: also hellfire.mpq, hfmonk.mpq, hfmusic.mpq, hfvoice.mpq). A .zip or .7z containing the files works too. You can also do this later from the main menu.
\n
\nIf you don\'t have the original game then you can buy Diablo from GOG.com.
The free shareware version is built in and plays right away.
See the Installation Instructions for more details.
This game requires a gamepad to play
Please install a file explorer to select the files you want to import.
On the next screen, select the game files (or a .zip or .7z containing them). They are imported into:\n\n%1$s
The following files will be overwritten. Is this okay?\n\n%1$s
RAR files can\'t be opened on Android. Use a .zip or .7z, or import on PC.
Game installers can be imported in DETH on PC. On Android, pick DIABDAT.MPQ or a .zip/.7z containing it.
%1$s needs Android 8.0 or newer to open. Use a .zip, or pick DIABDAT.MPQ directly.
